Package com.squad93.pos.ui

Class Product

java.lang.Object
com.squad93.pos.ui.Product
public final class Product extends Object
An immutable cashier catalog item with an exact decimal base price and optional seasonal dates. Callers supply valid prices and either two ordered seasonal bounds or two null bounds; constructors retain their values without validation.
Author:
Daniel Wang, Tejas Kalpathi

    • Product

      public Product(int id, String name, BigDecimal price, LocalDate seasonalStartDate, LocalDate seasonalEndDate)
      Captures a catalog item and its saved seasonal bounds without validating them.
      Parameters:
      id - menu item identifier
      name - drink display name
      price - base price per drink before toppings and tax
      seasonalStartDate - inclusive first seasonal day, or null for all year
      seasonalEndDate - inclusive last seasonal day; must be present when the start is present

    • isInSeason

      public boolean isInSeason(LocalDate date)
      Checks the inclusive seasonal range; year-round items always pass. This method checks season dates only, so callers must separately enforce the database availability flag.
      Parameters:
      date - date to check; must be non-null for a seasonal item
      Returns:
      true for year-round items or dates within both seasonal bounds
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a seasonal item is checked with a null date or lacks its end date

    • getSeasonalDates
